periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward orientation approximately 45 degrees from the horizontal facial midline towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical oval geometry with a height approximately double the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant inferior extension forming a tapered teardrop morphology reaching toward the maxillary region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shaped curvature across the posterior dorsal margin with a relatively smooth boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent width across the visible dorsal plane, covering approximately 25-30 percent of the visible longitudinal torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance approximately twice the horizontal diameter of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, convex semicircular arcs on the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced chromatic shift from white to light-brown/soil-stained fur on the lower posterior pelvic region.
